title: Flatness and reduction data for the finite constant completion tower
statement: theorem finiteSystem_properties (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) [∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), Module (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U)] : (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), IsScalarTower A (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), Module.Flat (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), Function.Surjective (adicTransition J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n) U)) ∧ (∀ (m n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), ∃ e : TensorProduct A (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) m U) (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) ≃ₗ[A] adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) (min m n) U, ∀ (b : adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) m U) (a : A), e (b ⊗ₜ[A] Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = a • adicTransition J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) m (min m n) (Nat.min_le_left m n) U b)
